content.label: Brilliant app- I rely on it heavily. As it has many different tones, my brain doesn’t get used to the same tone so I always hear it. East to use, simple lay out. Thank you! 🤩

If another reminder app gets a snooze feature then this all will unfortunately fail to be a work while application. 

It lacks a lot of features that Apples own reminders app has such as shared reminders. 

It costs £3.99 for a yearly upgrade pass, however there has only been one upgrade in a year which was just to allow you to open links from notifications. 

The developer tells me that features such as shared reminder lists are too hard for him to develop. 

 on other occasions there has been over three year’s without new features.  

Such a shame as the all has so much potential

title.label: Better at nagging than my wife!

content.label:
This is the only app I have found that keeps me honest and ensures I get stuff done. 

Over the years I think I really have tried all the tasks / job manager apps. For the first time in all that time I finally have an app that makes sure I don’t forget anything. 

Thank you Mr/Ms Developer.
Been using this for years, best reminder app out there.

The most user-friendly, easy to configure yet feature rich app of its kind within a very crowded space. Highly recommended.
Should offer a better once-only purchase instead of the subscription on the App Store.

I’ve been using this as my primary reminder system for a long time and like it.
One suggestion is to differentiate between the event due time stamp and the reminder time stamp. If I have a meeting at 3pm on Tuesday then I want to see that in the reminder text - but I want to be reminded at 9am.

The release 21.12.8899 is a leap backwards when setting a timer. 
What was great, is now a convoluted mess. 
Also, with all releases, audible alerts seem hit and miss on my iPhone and Apple Watch.
My whole life is now run from this app - indispensable for those of us with dodgy memories!
21.11 date picker is painful. Please ’fix’ it, it was an incredibly easy to use app before this mistake was made.

title.label: No sound after upgrading to iOS 15

content.label: What the title says. Alarms without sound. Great…
Latest update deleted all my reminders!

I’m 80 and while the memory is still good, it’s not like it was. Without this app my life would be much more disorganised. I particularly like that when a reminder comes up it keeps going and doesn’t stop until you dismiss it. Lots more excellent features. Frequently improved and updated too. Love it.
This a really good App.  It works well and is very easy to learn to use. Never forget anything again!
My memory isn’t great anymore, this app really helps so that I don’t forget anything. It is so easy to use and is very customisable. I would highly recommend it!!!
I use Due every day. It’s the best reminders app I’ve ever used (and I’ve tried lots). It’s well-designed snd continues to be improved regularly with new features. Excellent.
Really simple and uncomplicated with fantastic snooze flexibility which is not found on other “to do” apps.

title.label: Custom snooze now working again after update

content.label:
Edit: Thank you for the response. The update fixed the issue..five stars again.

Custom snooze not working...greyed or rather whited out, so can’t see how long when pulling screen down to adjust times. Pulling down on the bottom white part of the screen where there should be hours and minutes only gives the option of 2 mins, 2 days, 2 months.

Slick, intuitive, a pleasure to use. 

Also I really appreciate that when using the parsing language function, you can actually keep the parse language in the reminder title and then adjust the time of the reminder. So for example if I want my reminder to be “Leave work at 5pm today”, I want that to pop up at 4.30 so I have time to wrap up - Due enables me to do that. 

It’s perfect for my needs - too many reminders apps want to take over your whole life and integrate everything. Due keeps it simple and does it very very well.

I pontificated long over purchasing Due, especially as I was already using one of the market leaders (OmniFocus). We tend to forget just how convenient it is to have everything synced across all devices. However sync is the only bugbear for me with Due. 

I set a due time on say my phone, then change it on my iPad and that updated information doesn’t get updated on the other devices so someone else in the house or office will be complaining that the phone has been going off every few minutes even though the actual time was updated.

I even had one reminder that went off a day and a half early, I’m sure it was correctly set, its a bit odd. Slightly disappointing.

If they could get the sync sorted on iCloud it would be a real winner. Until then I wouldn’t trust it for anything really critical.

A simple app, that does what it says. Laid out in a minimalistic way, and gives me all the info I need! Easy and fast too use. Doesn’t shove ads or a membership in my face. And I love the snooze feature! If I miss my reminder, it will hassle me for the next 30 mins with constant, yet not annoying notifications! Just fantastic!!🙌🏼🙌🏼🙌🏼

Finally a reminder app that really works! Apple’s one is woeful and though I don’t usually pay for apps this one is totally worth it. Very easy to set reminders in a variety of ways, and the best thing is you just can’t miss them as they keep reminding you and you have to go into the app to make them stop rather than just swiping away (which just snoozes them item). Would recommend unreservedly.

Apple’s reminders in iOS 13 just got worse with the lack of days of the week on the scroll wheel - so I went looking for something that worked in an intuitive, logical user friendly manner - Due fulfilled that criteria and oh so much more!
I will not be able to fully do this app justice here, but to add a little weight to how grateful I am to the creators of this app, I can tell you this is the only review I ever written in my life... about anything.

The various ways in which one can enter the timings for the reminder is wonderful; partly because it is easy, fast, so ‘end user’ practical and highly customisable; allowing for different people’s preferences and yet clean, clear and simple. It also enabled me to import my existing reminders from the Apple Reminders app - which is very useful because some of my reminders are not so much time related - just when I get an idea for something I jot it down as a reminder so I can add a date and time if I need to later.
I think intuitive intelligence went into the making of this app.

I’m going to finish waffling by saying - if you need a wonderful one time purchase (which is important to me) reminders app then get this - it just works! And even if Apple are clever enough to add days of the week! into their reminders app... I won’t be going back to it. I wish I’d found this years ago.

And to the creators... thank you so very much.

title.label: Never forget to cancel a subscription or pay a bill again!

content.label:
Due is great for nagging you (on a frequency you specify) to do a task. Got a reduced-price Audible subscription? Balance transfer on your credit card? Car MOT? Put it all in Due and have it remind you (and keep reminding you) when the date rolls around until it’s sorted.

Effortless and excellent.

I bought the original Due app and then I paid again for the new version (Which I’m quite happy to do because of the work involved in updating the app) but you now want me to pay £4 a year for a widget! Ridiculous! Its only £4 a year I hear you say! Well,every other app now wants you to pay a subscription to use all of the apps features so you could end up paying £100s every year just for your iOS apps! No thanks.I absolutely hate the subscription model and WILL NOT use any app that requires a subscription! I’m guessing plenty of people do use them otherwise they wouldn’t be offered but all I can say is more fool you, you have more money then sense! If I require a widget for the main reminders app I use I will look for another app to use.Very disappointing!
Used to be a great app before iOS 14. Now the reminders barely pop up and after paying for the app I’m told I now need to pay another £4 per yr to get widgets and maybe it will start working again?

I was a little doubtful about using two reminders apps, but this one adds so much in terms of nagging that I keep the stuff I really really have to do in here and the stuff that needs done sometimes in iOS reminders. My productivity and my ability to do what matters has gone through the roof.
Best app ever

So I paid for the app, but that’s not good enough for these guys, they now want me to subscribe to use a widget. This shows a complete lack of appreciation for your customers. For this reason, I cannot trust the app or developers to not introduce more charges, so it’s no longer a realistic option.

I BOUGHT this app a long time ago and up until now it was my go to for making quick reminders. Now iOS 14 is out they’ve seen this as an opportunity to get more money by locking widgets behind a paywall. True, 3.99 a year is nothing but it’s the principle. Another reminder app has added widget support and have asked nothing for it. I’ll migrate to that app. Done with Due

I’ve been using this app for just over a year and have just resubscribed to get access to the new widgets - but this is one app I’d willingly pay the subscription for even without new features. (Note: although it’s called a subscription , and will auto renew if not cancelled, you have permanently bought the add ins - so they are yours in perpetuity regardless of whether you continue to subscribe.)
I have a handful of apps that just make my life and work so much easier and more reliable (eg. Dropbox, Calendars5, Hour Tracker) and this is right up there with them as one of my daily essentials. I particularly find the snooze function brilliant as I can finish what I’m doing before having to address the reminder - or easily move it forward to a new day/time.
Absolutely worth your money. Let’s you set reminders/tasks easily and the gem is the reminder function- I haven’t found another app with this!

Guys, what have you done to the Mac app? It looks awful, unprofessional... People in Europe don’t use serif fonts, and it’s lilac, black or nothing? Sorry, it’s nothing for me. An amazing app, but I’m going to have to look elsewhere now 😔

I love the layout, so simple and the alert is fab. The only thing stopping me from using this as
My main reminders app is not having tick list for shopping items etc and not having a widget to quick glance what’s coming up today. Hoping this may be added at some point but loving it so far.
No option to add photos which would be a huge benefit to many Due users.  Developer has made a good app but not keeping up with development.  Don’t mind paying more for an improved product.

title.label: Remind me to write a review about Due!

content.label:
With this app you’ll never forget anything that’s really important ever again. Just add it to Due and it will be taken care of. There are so many nagging options so use this app with attention. I don’t add all my reminders to it, although that is an option too. Just the ones that are important one-offs plus some simple repeating tasks. 

The app now has the best subscription model available. Pay a small amount for a year and whatever new is added before your subscription runs out is to keep, even if you decide not to renew.  I am looking forward to some cool things being added to this app in the near future. New Shortcuts have just been added. Great.
 
I must also mention the Watch app. It’s so useful. Every time Due wants to remind me of something I get a tap on my wrist. Again, and again, and again. I can mark the task off, snooze it, or reschedule it. I can also set a task from my wrist if I feel like it. 

This app is THE best at what it does. I am very happy that I can support this developer with a small subscription each year.

The best reminder app I have found. Flexible on snooze times, you can set your own, really useful. 
Developer feedback is quick as well. 
Highly recommended.
So easy to use and set reminders. Really well kept up to date. Love this app

title.label: A key part of my productivity set!

content.label: Simple, reliable and integrates well. A good choice for setting regular reminders whether daily, annually or anything else you choose

This app is a perfect example of ‘less is better’. From its simple, sleek interface to its ease of use it’s what I need in my hectic life to set reminders quickly and easily. 

I don’t need 500 other features, and clever bells and whistles that other ‘to do’ app developers feel the need to shove in.  I just need to be able to set reminders quickly and have absolute confidence that they won’t disappear. Having the default auto snooze baked in is a stroke of genius!
What I love about this app is how it just won’t leave you alone until you acknowledge what you’ve set as a reminder. Simply put, it’s peace of mind.

title.label: Dependable Alarms That Keep Pestering You!

content.label: I basically run with busy life as a parent and software architect with Due. I love how it keeps reminding you until you mark a job as done or choose to actively defer it. The watch app makes this super convenient and simple too. The interface is straightforward and usable. The cloud sync works well, keeping updates rapidly synced across my iDevices. It’s like my own Executive Assistant and it’s awesome.

title.label: iOS app great, WatchOS app useless

content.label:
Edit: 2020-01-23 (previous review at bottom)

Indispensable. Helps me get through the day by reminding my addled brain to do all those little things that would otherwise fall by the wayside. If it’s something that occurs with a repeatable pattern, I probably have it in Due. 

Pleased to report that the Watch companion app now behaves beautifully too. 

===

Previous review
—
The iOS app is great, I'd give it five stars, although the recent changes in iOS to the number of notifications have not been good for Due. Sometimes, "nag" reminders just stop. Otherwise great. 

The WatchOS app is a total waste of time, to the extent that I'd advise anyone buying with the intention of relying on the Watch app not to waste their money. Most of the time, the app is unresponsive, and completing reminders and stopping timers, when the app does work, is a lottery. It is one of those cases where you're better off using normal Watch notifications rather than this very poor Watch app. 1 star.

So, an average of three stars, then. I'll revisit this if the developer improves the WatchOS performance.

title.label: App doesn’t respond to making corrections well

content.label: I’ve had this and other versions of this app for years and it is good. However, support is non-existent. The last 2 versions of the app have trouble with placing the cursor in reminders you need to edit. In all other apps, the cursor behaves as expected but In this app, it is extremely difficult to place a cursor before or after a word. Instead it selects the whole word or a number of words. Trying to correct that leads to further cursor placing problems. The only way to do it is by using the trackpad by pressing the space bar. I am looking for another app that is as good as this but better with editing.

The app has good options and reminds well while it is running. 

Unfortunately the app stops running in the background after say a couple of days of running. Then I need to open the app to get it running again and it will start showing all the due items one by one. So for me it’s a wasted purchase and the app does not keep up its promise.
As long as you put it in!!
I use this App every day and it makes keeping tag of things a breeze. It has all the features I’ve found missing in other Apps and they update it frequently.

Probably the one absolute 'must have' app on my phone. Depending on your needs, with Due, you can more or less give up on using the calendar if all you need is a nudge. It's packed with hidden features that still pop out and surprise me a year after installing. 

Overall, simply outstanding.
I’ve been using Due for a number If years, now almost exclusively for repeating reminders and for timings/alarms. Way better than  Reminder etc for the repeats, I rely on it.

I love this App, use it constantly and have given it 5 stars before. My only request is for more colour options, please. A recent update has included a new black theme, but that is of no use to me with older eyesight. Otherwise, it is all grey and white and rather dull.

UPDATE: Due is still the best reminder/task App out there, but PLEASE introduce colour options and perhaps some emojis so that that different tabs can be distinguished better. Great design otherwise. With colour options instead of dull grey/black, it would get 5 + stars from me.
Simple, fast and reliable. Use it for everything, dentist, shopping, birthdays etc. Absolutely love it!
